author: reek
body: Locks in the dwt-insert aliasing fix. list-set-at mutates in place and arguments evaluate left to right, so the swap's second read of slot i must happen before the first write lands. Before the fix the inner set stored slot i minus one into slot i, then the outer argument re-read slot i and wrote that same value back down: the sort filled with duplicates instead of swapping, and dwt-compress picked its threshold from a corrupted ranking.
